verificationPolicy.shardAssignment: lexicographic sourcePath order index modulo shardCount
verificationPolicy.proofRequirement: full normalized runtime relative path equality + at least one Sprite exact hit + decoded RGBA + non-empty alpha
verificationPolicy.nonSpriteExactPathCompanions: recorded but do not invalidate a valid Sprite exact hit
verificationPolicy.locatorGapClassification: REVIEW only; filtered candidate-bundle miss does not prove NOT_IN_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT

bulkResultHashContract: sha256(UTF-8 compact JSON of results sorted by exact sourcePath)
